metadata.dataset: Germany Speed Camera Master — Rich Open/Official Merge

deduplication.method: nearest coordinate match; source provenance preserved

important_limitations: No public dataset can guarantee every physical or currently active speed camera in Germany.
The Germany-wide base source is OSM-derived and its exact source snapshot freshness is not guaranteed by speedcams.world.
Official Karlsruhe/Rheinstetten data is merged where available; official coverage is not nationwide.
Mobile enforcement locations should be handled as temporary/mobile-zone data, not as permanent fixed cameras.
For navigation warnings, do not trigger solely by radial distance. Snap cameras to the routing graph and match route direction/carriageway.

not_embedded_but_recommended_live_or_bui.name: Open-GATSO-POI
not_embedded_but_recommended_live_or_bui.reason: Current EU feed includes Germany and additional enforcement categories; use in the build pipeline after validating per-source redistribution/provenance.

not_embedded_but_recommended_live_or_bui.name: German municipal/open-government datasets
not_embedded_but_recommended_live_or_bui.reason: Examples include Düsseldorf fixed speed/red-light data, Bottrop measurement sites, Wesel/Kleve mobile and stationary measurement data, Essen planned controls.

not_embedded_but_recommended_live_or_bui.name: Live/community provider adapter
not_embedded_but_recommended_live_or_bui.reason: Can supplement mobile/temporary reports online, but should remain separate unless redistribution terms explicitly permit bundling.
